patterns: APPSC asks single-fact superlatives: longest river of Asia (Yangtze), deepest lake (Baikal), longest coastline (Canada), highest waterfall Angel Falls (3,212 ft), Dead Sea depth (1,385 ft).
APPSC likes 'which is NOT' items (Victoria not a Great Lake) and river-mouth facts (Danube -> Black Sea, Mississippi -> Gulf of Mexico); its key uses Gulf of Mexico, not 'Atlantic'.
Other PSC/UPSC staples: Mekong not through Malaysia, Caspian not bordering Armenia/Iraq, Black Sea not Croatia/Syria, Kiel = North Sea-Baltic, Michigan wholly in USA, Victoria Falls on Zambezi.
Many filed PYQs are political geography / current affairs, not physical water bodies.
App MCQs are heavier on multi-statement and 4-way match items with dated LENS/VIS trivia (Black Sea salinity, Hormuz UNCLOS) than APPSC's direct one-liners; AP angle (Pulicat, Kolleru) is covered.
